summary.en: The NEXT UNICORN Project is the Korean Mother Fund's first dedicated AI/deep-tech fund-of-funds program, run by Korea Venture Investment Corp. (KVIC) under the Ministry of SMEs and Startups. It concentrates 550 billion+ won into AI and deep-tech, splitting KRW 300bn of Mother Fund commitments equally across 'startup' and 'scale-up' tracks (the latter targeting 10+ billion won per company). In the 2025 2nd call, the Mother Fund committed KRW 310 billion to form KRW 590.7 billion of sub-funds across 15 GPs, with named AI-fusion managers including Acestone Ventures, K-Net Investment Partners, Tony Investment and Hyundai Technology Investment.

Selected GPs must invest at least 60% of fund capital into the AI value chain — AI infrastructure (chips, data centers, cloud), AI models (NLP, speech, etc.), AI applications, and AI transformation (AIX) — and at least 60% into SMEs.

summary.en: The AI Korea Fund is a Korea Development Bank (KDB) program to build out the domestic AI value chain, targeting KRW 1.5 trillion over 2024–2026. In its 2025 GP selection, five managers — Stonebridge Ventures (mid-cap, target KRW 200bn), STIC Ventures, We Ventures, Kolon Investment and Kiwoom Investment (small-cap) — were chosen to form roughly KRW 525 billion of sub-funds, each required to put at least 60% of capital into the AI value chain (infrastructure, models, applications, AI transformation).

sources.quote: 산업은행은 지난 2024년부터 2026년까지 3년간 총 1조5000억원 규모를 조성한다 … ▲AI 인프라(반도체·데이터센터·클라우드) ▲AI 모델(자연어처리·음성인식 등) ▲AI 응용서비스 ▲AI 전환(AIX)

verification_notes: Government LP/fund-of-funds program (KDB), not a direct-investing fund. Sub-fund sizes are targets at GP selection; actual closes can differ (e.g., Kolon closed KRW 203bn vs. KRW 100bn target). USD figures are approximate conversions.
